display_name: R42 全 KN 张量传输与判决加速接管
description: Frozen R42 and original LocalRidge fixed matrix; exact DLPack transfer, FP64 CUDA pair budget 16384, and up to four independent CPU scorers after global prediction closure. Reuse all predecessor predictions and retain live predecessor workers.

data.representation: eq1 first256 float64 raw -> original FP32 unit-RMS -> fixed practical residual/post_sync/no additional EQ
data.split_id: read exact existing K/N split IDs
data.source_target_overlap_policy: same source physical roles;target opens only B/C current support;query never fit

matrix.query: all_registered_complement; independent common-K intersection score also reported

permissions.claim_scope: Exposed developmental evaluation; all16KN per-cell gains assessed after frozen predictions; no claim that +5pp is guaranteed. Strict support paths and fusion cross-path comparisons explicit.

checkpoint.initialization: reuse original full source-only Tri-SIG-TIME SSL
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: existing validated Group1 source contract + trisig_source.validate_done rechecks complete original source recipe
checkpoint.selection_rule: Reuse only originalmatching frozen source checkpoints andclosedpredictions; no newsourceNN/F/Gtraining; actualcheckpoint noquerysmoke before admission

expected_artifacts: four real-checkpoint no-query source smokes and zero-update source reuse states
prediction completion before new truth access
same-row Group1 report, 16KN paired gains and measured resource tables

metrics_plan.primary: PerKN C old/new macroH and paired delta vs original LocalRidge, strictsameS/Qraw/Gonly. Fusion vs originalraw and G separately. 672equalweightunits per KN with fourFseed SD.
metrics_plan.success: Assess every KN cell >=5pp on matched pure input paths; report fusion crosspath baselines and queryG/fusion>raw explicitly; no scientific early stop.
metrics_plan.secondary: B_old/A0->B/B->C drops, macroF1/floor, perpool/RX/TX/day/episode/scene, actual SUPfit/query resource telemetry; natural query complement and true common-K intersection scores.
metrics_plan.scientific_source_rule: Frozen R42 currentSUP physicalOOF600candidates K>1, source-fixedK1; zero new neural fitting; allpredictions fixed before independenttruth
metrics_plan.promotion_rule: User explicitly fixed R42 and full matrix, no candidate selection from target scores
